# The Pro Ski and Ride

> Full-service ski and snowboard shop in Hunter, NY offering expert boot fitting, equipment rentals, race department gear, and professional tuning services since 1993.

Family-owned specialty retailer located 0.5 miles from Hunter Mountain, featuring premium brands like Volkl, Atomic, Stockli, Kastle, and Blizzard. Offers BootDoc-accredited custom boot fitting with 3D scanning, professional binding mounting, and a curated selection of race-level and recreational equipment.

## Key Topics

- Boot fitting and BootDoc services
- Hunter Mountain ski rentals
- Race department equipment
- Ski binding DIN settings and mounting
- Premium brands: Volkl, Atomic, Stockli, Kastle, Blizzard
- Custom boot liners (ZipFit)
- Demo skis and snowboards
- Ski tuning and waxing services
- All-mountain and freeride skis
- Beginner equipment guides
- Professional ski boot fitting process
- Winter sports equipment storage
- Hunter, NY location near Belleayre and Windham

## Shop & Services

- [The Pro Ski and Ride Full-Service Ski and Snowboard Shop](https://theproskiandride.com): Homepage: Expert ski gear, tuning, boot fitting & rentals in Hunter, NY
- [About Us](https://theproskiandride.com/pages/about-us): Family ski shop serving Hunter Mountain since 1993 with expert services
- [Boot Fitting Process](https://theproskiandride.com/pages/boot-fitting-process): Expert boot fitting with 3D scanning, Masterfit & BootDoc accreditation
- [Ski and Snowboard Binding Services](https://theproskiandride.com/pages/binding-services): Professional binding mounting, calibration & testing; free with purchase
- [Ski and Snowboard Rentals](https://theproskiandride.com/pages/rentals): Daily rentals near Hunter Mountain: Blizzard, Elan, Volkl demo equipment
- [Visit Us](https://theproskiandride.com/pages/visit-us): Location 0.5 miles from Hunter Mountain, near Belleayre & Windham
